source_title: War Clocks, Secret Factions, And AI As A Parasite On Mass Society
summary: This October 26, 2025 Propaganda & Co. interview is a high-pressure routing source: it adds an adjacent October forecast-family layer around Iran/Hormuz/Third Temple timing, internal-faction geopolitics, Odessa/NATO escalation, Trump third-term and civil-unrest scenarios, Roman gerontocracy, imagination as civilizational force, and AI as dependent on mass society.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: Jiang names Hormuz as one of the two decisive escalation tests for a second Iran-Israel round because closure would drag in the wider world through oil and Asian-economy pressure.
existing_lens_links.rationale: The active mechanism is route access and energy chokepoint pressure, not a standalone Iran War or Hormuz page.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: Jiang says bureaucratic power can be crossed by secret-society coordination, and that otherwise competing factions can temporarily converge through eschatological scripts around Israel, World War III, the Third Temple, and the Antichrist.
existing_lens_links.rationale: Secret Society owns the coordination-through-hidden-script mechanism; Eschatology owns sacred role sequence. The source has explicit rumor and speculation caveats, so it should not be treated as proof of all named networks.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: Jiang states that conflict within states is often more important than conflict between states, then applies the rule to Israel, Iran, Washington, Ukraine, Trump, and American civil-unrest pressure.
existing_lens_links.rationale: The existing Proximity Games anchor owns the nearest internal game governing apparent foreign-policy action. This source is another strong formulation, but no episode link should be applied until a later provenance pass chooses exact public marks.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: Jiang calls AI a parasite on mass society and says it depends on billions of people, energy, and stable large-scale social conditions rather than self-propelling machine intelligence.
existing_lens_links.rationale: Mass Society owns the population-scale dependency and control surface; AI As Control Surface owns the answer/interface and AGI skepticism only when the machine interface is primary.

concept_extensions.boundary_note: Secret Society owns coordination form and hidden trust. Bureaucracy owns slow hierarchy; Eschatology owns sacred content; Strategy owns material war feasibility.

concept_extensions.boundary_note: Chokepoint owns access, corridors, oil, and geography. The page is already in size-watch, so this should feed comparison or replacement, not another ordinary append.

new_lens_seeds.title: AI As Parasite On Mass Society
new_lens_seeds.core_mechanism: AI is not an autonomous civilizational successor but a dependent apparatus that needs mass population, commodity creativity, energy, and stable infrastructure; when the mass-society substrate collapses, the machine loses its apparent power.
new_lens_seeds.why_reusable: The source gives a crisp formulation that could help route future AI bubble, AGI skepticism, creativity, energy, data-center, and population-scale control claims without turning all of them into AI-control prose.
new_lens_seeds.reason: Hold as a routing seed. The mechanism is strong, but Mass Society and AI Control already cover adjacent surfaces; promote only if later clustered sources require a narrow hover or replacement/compression pass.

new_lens_seeds.title: War Clock As Sacred And Material Trigger
new_lens_seeds.core_mechanism: A coming conflict becomes watchable through a small set of triggers that are both material and sacred: Hormuz closure internationalizes oil pressure while Al-Aqsa/Third Temple events internationalize eschatological pressure.
new_lens_seeds.why_reusable: The trigger-pair could help compare future Iran-war forecast families, but it currently overlaps Chokepoint, Eschatology, Prediction, and No-Exit rather than standing as a public concept.
new_lens_seeds.reason: Hold as forecast-family vocabulary, not a page. The useful action is comparison and boundary routing, not concept proliferation.

chronology_notes.note: Dated 2025-10-26, this source lands one day after the CapitalCosm October 25 Strait/New Triumvirate source and gives a neighboring version of the same late-2025 pressure: second Iran round, Hormuz, eschatological trigger, China mediation, Odessa, and U.S. civil-unrest/third-term scenarios.

This source may become an earlier public formulation of the AI-as-dependent-substrate argument before later AI bailout/data-center and public-control-grid sources; it rejects AGI and says AI survives only while mass society, energy, and population scale remain intact.

The source explicitly marks several claims as rumor or speculative modeling, including red-heifer sacrifice reports, Third Temple assembly rumors, Washington tolerating China-Iran support, and Trump-health/civil-war chatter; future public use should preserve those caveats.
